release_signal.rule: Earliest date a test-run-linked bug reached status 'Done' while Fix Version included bigpicture-cloud-8.68.* (changelog replay; status name must be exactly Done).

timing.rule: Weekdays only (Mon–Fri), from the first to the last status change on any test in this Test Execution (getTestExecution.testRuns activity, field status). Same calendar day counts as 0.
